🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Healthcare) and style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: UNH (1W: +9.28% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +20.90%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +6.33% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate/REITs also showing strength: PSA (1W: +7.93% | 1M: +3.80%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -7.82% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -8.59% | 1M: -2.61%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.46% | 1M: -3.14%) BELOW TREND. Communication and Materials also weak with NEM (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -15.23%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: MDT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.28% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +7.19%) ABOVE TREND, PSA (1W: +7.93% | 1M: +3.80%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +20.90%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentrated: Narrow (4/5 Healthcare).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NEM (1W: -10.01% | 1M: -15.23%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -10.42% | 1M: +4.22%) CORRECTION, PANW (1W: -12.34% | 1M: +25.32%) CORRECTION, CRM (1W: -12.69% | 1M: -3.56%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -13.21% | 1M: -4.16%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Materials and Software names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: MDT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.28% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +7.19%) ABOVE TREND; watch ISRG (1W: +6.04% | 1M: -5.21%) RECOVERY for short-term follow-through. Major 1W vs 1M divergences in large-cap techs merit monitoring.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is under pressure: AAPL (1W: -7.82% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -8.59% | 1M: -2.61%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -18.57% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND. Sector-wide 1W weakness (-7.96%) alongside multiple CORRECTION patterns suggests rotation risk within Tech.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are steady-to-constructive: JPM (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +3.51%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +2.18%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +3.68% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY. Financials show internal strength but mixed sentiment headlines warrant selective exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is the clearest leader: MDT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +20.90%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth and earnings/news flow point to durable rotation into defensives/health.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Given NEUTRAL regime and concentrated healthcare leadership, favor selective Healthcare and defensive exposure while reducing exposure to large-cap Tech showing short-term breakdowns; monitor Financials for selective opportunities. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; be selective given narrow leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +20.90%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed; UNH (1W: +9.28% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND — momentum intact. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: +5.03%) CORRECTION — negative news confirming distribution; MSFT (1W: -8.59% | 1M: -2.61%) BELOW TREND — watch continuation.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +5.29%, 17 stocks) — leadership to monitor. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -7.96%, 24 stocks) — watch for extended weakness and potential trend breaks.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for failure to reclaim recent 1M trend and hold above short-term support (NVDA (1W: -6.46% | 1M: -3.14%) BELOW TREND). AAPL (1W: -7.82% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND — watch 1W continuation for further breakdown. JPM (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +3.51%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for follow-through above recent highs.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+80): Eli Lilly FDA nod; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +20.90%) — sentiment confirmed. MA (+60): NY crypto license; MA (1W: +3.68% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY — mixed headlines, watch follow-through. V (+55): OpenAI partnership; V (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +2.18%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment supportive. AMZN (+55): AI-related deal; AMZN (1W: -4.81% | 1M: -10.45%) BELOW TREND — positive headline but price diverging.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MA (-80): Settlement headline creates near-term headline risk; MA (1W: +3.68% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY — conflicting signals. V (-65): same settlement risk; V (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +2.18%) ABOVE TREND — news could sap momentum. ORCL (-55): AI spending headline; ORCL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: +5.03%) CORRECTION — sentiment and price confirm distribution. JNJ (-50): talc verdict risk; JNJ (1W: +6.33% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND — watch for legal headline drag despite strong price action.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. UNH (1W: +9.28% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND, MDT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.57% | 1M: +20.90%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: concentrated healthcare leadership and major tech divergences (ORCL, AVGO, NOW showing 1W weakness vs 1M strength) — monitor for trend breaks and sentiment-driven reversals.
